analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported a resilient performance in Q1 FY27 despite a challenging operating environment marked by raw material inflation and geopolitical tensions in West Asia. The company achieved a 35% year-on-year revenue growth to ₹532 crore and a 36% EBITDA growth to ₹89 crore. Management expressed confidence in achieving a 30%-35% turnover growth for the year, supported by the ramp-up of its expanded NPK-DAP capacity and a revival in monsoon conditions. Krishana Phoschem Limited commenced FY27 on a resilient note, with Q1 revenue growing 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore and PAT increasing 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore. The company's expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP and Sulphuric Acid are now contributing progressively to its performance.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover growth over the previous year.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management believes EBITDA margins will remain healthy in the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: However, our performance in this quarter has been better than expected, and we believe EBITDA margins will remain healthy in the coming quarters as well.

guidance.claim: Management is confident in maintaining operational and financial momentum through the remainder of FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

guidance.claim: Management expects growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management expects a top-line increase of around Rs. 500 crore from the expanded capacity, bringing total revenue to around Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000 crore.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore. So, this year we had around Rs. 2,400 odd crore. So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

guidance.claim: Management expects 40% revenue growth including import and manufacturing.
guidance.quote: Yes, including the import and manufacturing we expect 40% growth should not be a big issue.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue growth for FY27 to comprise a 25% growth in manufacturing alongside approximately Rs. 1,000 crore from imported material.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue. And based on the capacity utilization on a reasonable level, the growth in the manufacturing will be in the range of 25%.

demand_outlook.claim: The decline in industry production was due to supply-side constraints rather than weak underlying fertilizer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: This indicates that the decline in production was primarily due to supply-side constraints, including raw material availability and logistic challenges, rather than any weakness in underlying fertilizer demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and continued government subsidy support are expected to support fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving in monsoon conditions, higher MSP and continued government support through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are expected to support the fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth due to strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and continued government backing through the NBS framework are creating a favorable operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: The Kharif season demand environment appears constructive due to comfortable domestic stock levels and a favorable monsoon forecast.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops approached maturity.
demand_outlook.quote: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity consistent with typical fertilizer application cycles.

demand_outlook.claim: The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with comfortable inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonnes.
demand_outlook.quote: The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with comfortable inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonne indicating balanced supply-demand conditions and healthy channel inventory levels.

demand_outlook.claim: A stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure, and domestic demand remains non-negotiable due to essential food consumption.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently evaluating capacity expansion opportunities.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its NPK-DAP capacity by 165,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: As we have already mentioned, we have expanded our NPK-DAP capacity by 165,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: The green ammonia capacity under the SECI agreement is scheduled to start in FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP and Sulphuric Acid are now contributing progressively to performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: NPK/DAP capacity was enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity stands at 120,000 MTPA, bringing total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: The production and sales of new NPK products contributed to the improvement in EBITDA.
margins_costs.quote: The production and sales of these new NPK products during the quarter contributed to the improvement in EBITDA.

margins_costs.claim: Lower-cost inventory carried forward from the previous quarter contributed to higher EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs did contribute to the higher EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: From mid-February onwards, the global market witnessed firming input prices driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, and higher logistic and freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Ammonia and sulphur prices moved up sequentially during the quarter, creating cost pressure in the closing quarter.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, ammonia prices moved up sequentially during the quarter. Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March. This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for manufacturing stood around Rs. 5,500 per ton in FY26 compared to around Rs. 6,000 per ton in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: It was in the range of Rs.5,500 per ton.

margins_costs.claim: Overall EBITDA margin came down from 13.54% to 12.34%.
margins_costs.quote: Our overall EBITDA margin, which was 13.54% has come down to 12.34%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total NPK-DAP capacity has reached 495,000 MT after adding 165,000 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved 43% capacity utilization of the NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's manufacturing sales volume was 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP and 36,300 MT for SSP.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed capacity of 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Fertilizer production for the quarter reached 94,103 MT, with certain units operating above 100% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total annual production reached 397,263 MT with record high utilization levels in NPK/DAP and SSP plants operating above rated capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

capital_allocation.quote: Collection is more than Rs. 700 crore.

capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

risks_headwinds.claim: The first quarter faced a challenging operating environment driven by supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: The 1st Quarter witnessed a challenging operating environment for the phosphatic supplier industry, primarily driven by global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia introduced considerable uncertainty across global fertilizer supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices rose significantly from April to June and July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorables.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

risks_headwinds.claim: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, global input movements have a direct impact on the cost structure.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.
